text:
melissa: Quick heads-up — vendor bringing a mini-fridge demo at 3pm. U-Haul plate ends 7K9. Need someone at loading dock? Also one fragile crate labeled "snowman" inside.
frontdesk: @melissa noted. Can you add vendor name for check-in? Badge kiosk low on white labels.
melissa: Vendor = CoolTek Labs (contact: dan@cooltek.io). I'll add to visitor list now.
frontdesk: Thanks. Badge printer shows `low_toner` error on the kiosk. If someone can pick up labels from supplies closet A, that'll fix temp badges.
ryan: I can swing by supplies closet in 10. Also, does anyone want temporary dibs on fridge space in the lounge? :fridge: 
lina: I call dibs for morning coffee storage :raised_hands: 
jamie: Only if you promise not to fill it with condiments, lina. :joy: 
people-ops: FYI — for loading dock: vendor needs a parking pass. @melissa can you grant a day-pass in the visitor form? Also please mark crate as "fragile" in notes.
melissa: Done. Day-pass added. Crate flagged as fragile and "do not stack".
frontdesk: Dock volunteer assigned: ryan. I'll meet vendor at 2:55 to escort to dock and handle badges.
badge-bot: [system] Badge printer status: LOW_TONER. Estimated usable labels: 12. Order placed? no
ryan: I'll grab spare label roll from supply room and bring spare toner if needed. Where's the spare toner kept? code: "OfficeSupply-202"
lina: It's on top shelf B next to the extra lanyards.
jamie: Also FYI — a personal package for @olivia addressed "holiday snowman" arrived, left in locker 3. Front desk couldn't find a signature so we held it.
melissa: That's mine actually, thanks @jamie. I'll pick up after the demo.
frontdesk: All set — vendor checked in, fridge on dolly. ryan standing by at dock. Badge kiosk had one hiccup but labels replaced. :thumbsup: 
melissa: Huge thanks everyone. If the fridge ends up staying overnight, can we not block the couch area? People working late like that spot.
lina: noted, i'll move my stuff if needed.
jamie: Who wants first-rights at the demo snacks? :cookie: 
olivia: me me me 🙋‍♀️
melissa: Closing thread — vendor left a tiny snowman ornament in the crate. It's adorable. Front desk put it on the visitor shelf for now. :snowman:
